## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e40c1bd6bd0b79fe7b5b8f1497846c9c1ab5a20a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/queue.md + scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

PR #33732, PR 2 of 2 for card #33647 (items 1 to 3 and the charter widening, as triage comment 6889317333 splits them). Read: the card body and all six comments, the PR body, the six-file list, the net diff against merge-base `48e69596`, and the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read only to judge it: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`authorizedApprovalVerdict`, `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`), `check-half-states.mjs` (`readSignatureLine`), `validate.mjs` (the `session` envelope rule), `platform-readings.md` line 43, AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14, `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` lines 173 to 181.

Check-runs on the head when this record was written: every concluded run is success or skipped, none failed, and TWO ARE STILL IN PROGRESS — `Test Core (1/8)` and `Type Check · consumer gates`. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (the family that runs the fleet-write self-tests and the line ratchet), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` concluded success. The gate verdicts are therefore not all in: the seat reads the last two green before it lands anything.

### ① Derived judgments

- Relay op table gains `pr_dequeue` (required `pull`, `expected_head_sha`, `cause`, `reason`; nothing optional; travels alone). RIGHT: closed keys, a closed three-value `cause` enum, `reason` bounded at 1,000 bytes, `ALLOWED_MUTATIONS` gains `dequeuePullRequest` and nothing else.
- Token grant: a `pr_dequeue` stroke mints `merge-queues: write` through the existing stroke-scoped path, beside the five literal grants; every other stroke still writes an empty `permission_merge_queues`. RIGHT, and no workflow change is needed: `fleet-write.yml` line 181 passes the validator's output generically.
- `pr_enqueue_front` gains one optional key, `approval_comment` (a positive integer). Its accept set WIDENS: a pull over 3,000 lines is now accepted when `enqueueFrontSizeLift` lifts. RIGHT against item 2. The governed, release, draft, head and one-jump fences are untouched (the lift is OR-ed into the `size` fence alone).
- `mergeQueueOf` adds `rollup` to an entry only when the query selected `headCommit`; the jump's own read (`MERGE_QUEUE_READ_QUERY`) does not select it, so the jump's reading is byte-identical. RIGHT.
- `FIELDS` gains `cause`, `reason`, `approval_comment`; no existing row names them. RIGHT.
- Line ratchet: `landing-operations.md` 108 to 112 and `lanes/queue.md` 30 to 32, both at headroom 0 (measured on the head: 112 and 32 lines). Judged under ③.
- No package, schema or published surface moves.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff is `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, published by no package; `Check Changeset` concluded success on the head. `Clause-②: no` on the claim (6891021684) and the PR body is right: nothing here narrows or publishes a package contract.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, signature session (PR body and trailer carry the seat's session, the dev's own in `session`): accepted, it matches the claim's `Session:` line.
- Dev flag, two ratchet rows instead of one: accepted, both files the order names grew.
- Ceiling raises against the ratchet header (ruling 6184799323 letter B). The PR body and both CEILINGS comments quote card #33647 (filing gate ③) with the maintainer's verbatim words and the measured deltas (+4, +2). The header asks for a ruling comment's id; the ruling here is a card body, which carries no comment id, and the file already holds that form as landed precedent (#29160, #29420, #31403 rows: "the ruling of record is that card's body"). ACCEPTED. Every added line is ordered by the card: `landing-operations.md` +4 is the lift (item 2), the dequeue's two lines (item 1) and 「谁入队谁看护」 (item 3), with the §7 line folded at zero; `lanes/queue.md` is +3 −1, the lift (item 2), dequeue on an offline landing seat's behalf (item 4, third bullet) and the relay's audit and read-back (item 1). Nothing is left to be paid by deletion. The `ruledRaises` record (delta 4) matches.
- Carried for #33718 (ruling record 6891082225, letter B): 「发现立新卡」 to 「发现照立卡门入卡」. Meaning KEPT and corrected as ruled: findings enter cards through the filing gate, which no longer promises a NEW card per finding. 「落地后才见」 to 「落地后见」 drops only the emphasis; the condition (seen after landing) stands. Zero lines added.
- Dev flag, N2 not done (SKILL.md lane-table pointer, 340 of 341 bytes): accepted as reported; a row-pin raise needs its own ruling.
- Dev flag, `dequeuePullRequest` input and permission NOT MEASURED: answered under ④ (the door fails closed both ways). One more unmeasured reading is not on the dev's list, see N1.
- `open_questions`: empty.
- Out of scope, `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` line 173 "ONE consumer: the `pr_enqueue_front` row": STALE, comment only, no functional contradiction (the mint input is generic). Must be CARDED (class c, maintainer reach), not fixed here.
- Out of scope, AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 "no seat act, those two included, is measured to dequeue one ... ask the maintainer at once": it does NOT contradict the door today. It is a measurement sentence, and `pr_dequeue` is itself unmeasured until its first live stroke; its instruction (ask the maintainer, confirm in neither the queue nor `origin/main`) stays the safe one. It turns stale at the first landed stroke. Must be CARDED now, to be executed once that stroke is measured; the card should also carry S2 below, since PD#14's own confirmation is "neither the queue nor main".
- Item 5 (the App's `Merge queues: write` grant) is the maintainer's, named in the PR body. No escalation owed.

### ④ Design judgment

Fences I tried to break, and what held:

- App lacks the grant: the mint fails with zero writes (workflow, unchanged). Grant minted but the mutation refused, or the input shape wrong: a non-200, or a 200 carrying `errors`, is FAILED and nothing is read back; a landing needs BOTH no errors AND a whole queue read that no longer lists the pull. The door never reports success on a 200 alone. HOLDS. The input `dequeuePullRequest(input: { id })` with the pull's node id agrees with GitHub's published schema.
- Cause (a): `mergeable_state` must read `dirty` on the relay's own GET; `unknown` and null are refused. HOLDS.
- Cause (b): the entry must read `UNMERGEABLE` or a `FAILURE`/`ERROR` rollup on the relay's own queue read; null is refused. That it FAILED is the relay's reading; that the failure is the pull's OWN change and not a flake is the seat's word in `reason`, carried into the audit comment. The header says so plainly, and the card names the three-fact test as the judge. HOLDS as specified.
- Large-PR jump on an older head: refused without `approval_comment`. Dismissed approval: `authorizedApprovalVerdict` keeps the latest decisive review per reviewer, so a DISMISSED or CHANGES_REQUESTED after the approval removes it. Non-`GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval: never enters `approvals`. A full page of 100 reviews or an unread list lifts nothing. A push after the read is the platform's refusal (`expectedHeadOid`). HOLDS.
- Carried comment on another pull, by another author, or naming another head or a prefix under 7 characters: refused; the comment is read by its own GET inside `payload.repo`. HOLDS, with S3.

Findings:

- **S1 (should-fix) — `seat-asks` does not prove "its LANDING seat asks".** `sessionSignedOn` (`execute.mjs`) accepts any comment by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` whose first line is a signature naming `payload.session`. Two ways through for a seat that is not the landing seat: (1) it already has a signed relay comment on the pull — a reviewer's record, a triage knock, and notably the queue seat's own jump or ejection audit comment, which `lanes/queue.md` orders it to leave; (2) it posts one signed comment and then sends the dequeue. `payload.session` itself is self-declared (`validate.mjs` checks its shape only), and the relay's `comment` row does not bind a signature to the dispatching session. So the door enforces "some seat that has spoken on this pull", and `lanes/queue.md` 「(c) 只归落地席」 is held by prose alone, while `landing-operations.md` 「中继认其在该 PR 的签名评论」 reads as if the relay proves it. Bounded: a dequeue is recoverable and the audit comment names the session, and the jump's three reasons are prose-held the same way. Fix, either: tighten the proof to the pull's own landing identity (for example the seat, lane#N, of the signature on the pull's body or its signed trailer must equal the seat of the comment signed by `payload.session`), or keep the code and make both skill lines say what the relay actually reads and that (c) is the seat's declaration.
- **S2 (should-fix) — the read-back lands on "not listed" alone, with no "not merged" reading.** `dequeueReadBack` is OK as soon as the queue no longer lists the pull, and OK outright when the base reads no queue. `platform-readings.md` line 43 asks for the not-in-queue reading PLUS not landed, and PD#14's own remedy is "in neither the queue nor `origin/main`". A pull that leaves the queue by MERGING inside the 30 s window (reachable under `seat-asks`, whose pull may be green at the head of the queue; not under (a) or (b)) is reported as "out of the merge queue", a landed dequeue. Fix: on the read-back, re-read the pull and land only when it is still open and `merged` is false; a merged pull is FAILED naming the merge.
- **S3 (should-fix) — the carried approval can be "confirmed" by an agent-operated authorised account.** `enqueueFrontSizeLift` takes any comment whose author is in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` and whose text holds a 7+ character prefix of the head. AGENTS.md PD#14 says an authorised account is agent-operated too, and this card's own header shows a seat signing as `triage#1 · hotlong`. A seat-signed comment posted under such a login that merely quotes the head (a knock, a record with a `Head-sha:` line) satisfies the fence once a seat names it as `approval_comment`. The card's wording is "a carried approval the maintainer confirmed". Fix: refuse a carrying comment whose first non-empty line is a seat signature (`readSignatureLine` is already imported), with a self-test row each way.
- **N1 (nit) — `headCommit` is read as the entry's merge-group commit, unmeasured and not on the NOT MEASURED list.** `DEQUEUE_QUEUE_READ_QUERY` selects `headCommit { statusCheckRollup { state } }` and the header calls it "its merge-group commit's check rollup". GraphQL was closed to the dev, so this is from the schema docs like the mutation. The audit comment prints the rollup it read, so the first live `own-failure` stroke measures it. Follow-up: add it to the first-stroke measurement note on the card for item 5.
- **N2 (nit) — the audit comment can stand with no mutation behind it for a reason the relay already knew.** `dequeueAction` posts the comment and only then calls `graphqlVariables`, a second GET for a `node_id` the preflight's pull answer already holds. Sending `pre.pull.node_id` would close the "comment stands, node id unread" path. The failure row already names the comment, so nothing is misreported.
- **N3 (nit) — the grant is named only on the literal "not accessible by integration".** A `FORBIDDEN`-typed error worded otherwise is still FAILED with GitHub's own text, just without the `Merge queues: write` hint. Same shape as the jump's.
- **N4 (nit) — the skill names the causes by letter, the op takes `conflict` / `own-failure` / `seat-asks`.** A seat composing the stroke from `landing-operations.md` alone has to open `ops.mjs` for the three words and for `reason`. No line budget for it; fine as a pointer the refusal text already gives.

Sentence-by-sentence agreement, skill against code: the lift line, the three causes, "audit comment first, read back not listed to land", the refusal line (draft, head moved, governed, release) and the charter's "FAILED, no resend, report to the maintainer" each match `ops.mjs` and `execute.mjs`. The two sentences that say more than the code proves are the (c) sentences under S1. Card items 1, 2 and 3 and the charter widening are delivered; `automerge_disable` is untouched.

No must-fix. S1, S2 and S3 each earn a delta review of their fix on the new head; this record covers `e40c1bd6` only.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `febb3a986e6235d0d810d5052968bd01f040374f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/queue.md + scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

DELTA review of PR #33732 (card #33647, PR 2 of 2), from `e40c1bd6bd0b79fe7b5b8f1497846c9c1ab5a20a` to the head above: one commit, four files (the two skill files, `ops.mjs`, `execute.mjs`; 161 insertions, 62 deletions). `validate.mjs` and `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` are byte-identical to the prior head. Read: the card body and its six comments, the PR body, the six-file list, the net diff against main and the delta diff, the prior at-tier record 6891728476 on `e40c1bd6`, and the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read only to judge it: `dispatch.mjs` (`readPrBodyTrailer`, the `issue_patch` trailer rule), `check-half-states.mjs` (`readSignatureLine`, `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE`), `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`), `platform-readings.md` lines 16 to 20 and 43, `seat-post-protocol.md` line 30, AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 and the three-classes paragraph of the landing rule.

Check-runs on the head when this record was written: 48 runs, ALL COMPLETED, none pending, none failed. Success on every gate that ran, among them `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (the family that runs the fleet-write self-tests and the line ratchet), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. The rest are skipped by the affected-set filter; both `Check Changeset` runs read skipped on this head (the prior head read success), which is the `skip-changeset` label's path and not a red.

### ① Derived judgments

- `seat-asks` now reads the landing seat from the pull body's signed trailer (`readPrBodyTrailer` on the preflight's own pull GET) and holds only on a relay comment whose first line is a signature naming that lane#N, that account and `payload.session` (`signedByLandingSeat`). A body with no trailer skips the comment walk and is refused at the `cause` fence. RIGHT against the first fix the prior record offered.
- The read-back lands only when the queue no longer lists the pull AND the pull's own GET reads `state` open with `merged` false (`dequeuePullAfter`). Merged or closed is terminal FAILED with no re-read; a non-200 pull read is pending, re-read at the interval, and falls through to FAILED, UNCONFIRMED at the window. No path reports success on an unread pull. RIGHT.
- `enqueueFrontSizeLift` takes `signatureOf` and refuses a carrying comment whose first non-empty line is a seat signature; a missing reader carries nothing. RIGHT.
- The mutation is addressed by `pre.pull.node_id`; a pull read with no node id is refused before the audit comment. `graphqlVariables` is no longer called on this path and is unchanged for the jump and the transfer. RIGHT.
- The accept set of `pr_dequeue` and of the carried lift NARROWS relative to `e40c1bd6`; nothing widens. No op key, enum, grant or validator rule moved.
- Skill files: two lines changed in place in each file, none added. Measured on the head: `landing-operations.md` 112 lines, longest 120 bytes; `lanes/queue.md` 32 lines, longest 119 bytes. Ceilings 112 and 32 unchanged, headroom 0.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the prior record: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, published by no package, `skip-changeset` right, `Clause-②: no` right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The PR body's Acceptance notes name the round-1 fixes and send the stale `fleet-write.yml` comment and the PD#14 sentence to a follow-up card. Accepted; both stay out of this diff's reach. That card should also carry D1 below.
- N3 and N4 of the prior record are accepted by the dev as they stand. Accepted.
- The NOT MEASURED note now names the `headCommit` rollup reading, in the `ops.mjs` header and in the PR body.
- No ceiling moved in the delta; no new ruling is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

Prior findings: S1 closed, S2 closed, S3 closed, N1 closed, N2 closed. What I tried against each fix:

- S1. Who writes the trailer: the dev at `pr_create` under the owning seat's identity (this PR's own body shows it), or the seat on a later rewrite through `issue_patch` (`seat-post-protocol.md` line 30). The innocent overlap the prior record named is gone: the queue seat's jump comment, a review record, a triage knock, the landing lane#N under another account and the relay's own audit comment (which opens with no signature) are each refused, with a self-test row each. Body against comments: the trailer is read from the preflight's pull GET and the comments after it; a body edited between the two reads changes nothing, because the comment must match the seat the EARLIER read named, and the mutation goes to the node id of that same read. No ordering of the two reads lets a later edit pass. The trailer's own session is rightly not compared: a seat's session rotates (this card shows `domain:skills#1` under two sessions).
- S2. Merged inside the window, closed unmerged, pull read failing then answering, and a pull read failing until the window ends: FAILED naming the merge, FAILED naming the state, landed, and FAILED UNCONFIRMED. `merged` absent from the answer is pending, never a pass.
- S3. Seat-signed comment naming the head: refused, the reading names the seat. No reader passed in: refused.

Findings on this head:

- **D1 (should-fix) — the unmerged reading is ONE pull GET taken the instant the queue stops listing the pull.** `platform-readings.md` lines 16 and 17 record that `removed_from_merge_queue` and `merged` arrive in the same second or seconds apart in either order, and that a true ejection is "no `merged` after it, still open minutes later"; line 20 says `origin/main` is never read by the `merged` boolean. `dequeueAction` returns landed on the first open, `merged` false read, so a pull whose merge is recorded a few seconds after its entry disappears can still be reported "out of the merge queue and still open, unmerged". Reachable only under `seat-asks` on a green entry, and only if GitHub both accepts the dequeue and completes the merge, which is unmeasured. The landing seat's next act (fix and re-queue) would meet the merge at once, and nothing is written on the false reading. Fix: confirm with a second pull read one `DEQUEUE_POLL_MS` later before landing, or measure the gap at the first live `seat-asks` stroke and record it in `platform-readings.md`. It does not reopen S2 and can ride the follow-up card.
- **D2 (nit) — the landing-seat binding is to a DECLARED seat, by two typed texts.** A relay comment's lane#N and account are what the sender typed; no door compares them with the sender. A seat that types the landing seat's lane#N and account over its own session passes `signedByLandingSeat`, and a seat can also rewrite another seat's PR body with its own trailer through `issue_patch`, which checks only that the body is signed and the target is a pull. Both are deliberate forgeries of another seat's identity or state, already forbidden (AGENTS.md "State on your PR that you did not set belongs to another actor"), both leave the bot's edit and the audit comment naming the session, and a dequeue is recoverable. The `ops.mjs` header says it plainly ("does not prove who typed it"). No pin is available without a seat-to-session roster read; none is asked here.
- **D3 (nit) — first line only is enough for the carried approval; the residual is acceptable.** A comment under a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` login with the signature lower down, or with none, still carries. Judged against the rules: seats write only as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through `scripts/pm/` (AGENTS.md, the write-gate paragraph), and every seat post opens with its signature on line 1 or the door refuses it, so line 1 is exactly where an honest seat post is recognisable; a post under an approver's login without it is an off-door write that no reader can tell from the maintainer's hand, and the same is true of the APPROVED review itself, which PD#14 trusts by account alone. The lift also still requires a standing, undismissed authorised APPROVED review on this pull, and PD#14 lets a Tier H approval stand "on ANY commit ... later pushes included", with the over-3,000 class landing "the way a Tier H surface does". The jump's carried reading is therefore STRICTER than the landing rule it sits beside, and the comment grants no approval PD#14 would not already honour; PD#14's ban ("no agent seat submits an approving review ... under any account") is on the review, which this door never writes. Optional hardening, cheap if wanted: refuse a comment holding a signature on ANY line. The self-test row pinning "signature lower down still carries" would flip with it.
- **D4 (nit) — the reworded carry line no longer says an earlier approval must stand.** Both skill lines read 「维护者非席位签名评论点名现 head 承接」 with the object 「旧批准」 dropped for bytes. The code still refuses a comment with no authorised APPROVED review behind it and says so by name, so a seat misreading the line gets a refusal, not a jump.

Sentence-by-sentence, skill against code on the changed lines: 「(c) PR 正文签名尾行之席以签名评论自请」 and 「(c) 中继只认正文签名尾行之席」 match `readPrBodyTrailer` plus `signedByLandingSeat`; 「审计评论在先,回读离队且仍开未合才落地」 and 「仍在队或已合即 FAILED」 match `dequeueAction` (closed unmerged is FAILED too, which the line does not contradict); 「维护者非席位签名评论」 matches the first-line refusal. Nothing the delta touched broke: the jump's read, the five other fences of the dequeue, the audit-first order and the pacing are as on `e40c1bd6`, and the batteries that pin them concluded green on the head.

No must-fix. This record covers `febb3a98` only.

Head-sha: `94df19bc941ee89740dfe37f69699ddf463f6be9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/queue.md + scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

DELTA review of PR #33732 (card #33647, PR 2 of 2), from `febb3a986e6235d0d810d5052968bd01f040374f` to the head above. The delta is the fix commit `0bbf4a3a` (`execute.mjs` 24 insertions and 11 deletions, `ops.mjs` 4 and 2) plus a merge of `origin/main` at `a557fa38` (PR #33731). Read: the card body and its six comments, the PR body, the six-file list, the net diff against main at the head, the delta diff, the merge's two parents, the prior at-tier records 6891728476 and 6892058186, and the check-runs on the head. Code outside the delta was read only to judge it: `rest` in `execute.mjs` (how a failed read answers), `dequeuePullAfter`, `dequeueReadBack` and `enqueueFrontSizeLift` in `ops.mjs`, `platform-readings.md` lines 16 to 20 and 43.

Check-runs on the head when this record was written: 48 runs, ALL COMPLETED, none pending, none failed; 26 success and 22 skipped by the affected-set filter or the `skip-changeset` path. Success includes `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Test Core`, `TypeScript Type Check` and `Dogfood Regression Gate`. The `Lint · repo & tooling gates` log on this head prints: fleet-write/execute self-test 415 cases across 30 batteries, validate 428 across 22, dispatch 401 across 32, check-skill-line-ratchet self-test 164 cases. Those are the numbers the PR body states.

### ① Derived judgments

- The dequeue's landing now needs, after the queue stops listing the pull, TWO reads of the pull's own GET one `DEQUEUE_POLL_MS` (3 s) apart, both answering `state` open with `merged` false. RIGHT against D1's first offered fix. The accept set of a landed `pr_dequeue` NARROWS; nothing widens.
- No op key, enum, fence, grant, validator rule or mutation moved. `validate.mjs` and both skill files are byte-identical to `febb3a98`. `execute.mjs` and `ops.mjs` differ from `febb3a98` by exactly the fix commit; the merge touched neither.
- Battery floor for the dequeue: 27 to 28, one new row. The declared name in `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` and the `battery(...)` call carry the same edited sentence ("on two reads one interval apart"), the battery holds 28 `t(` rows on the head, and the total 415 is what CI printed. The number 28 is named only in `execute.mjs` (the ledger row and its comment); `ops.mjs`, `validate.mjs` and the skill lines name no count, so there is nothing to disagree with. The "two reads one poll apart" statement reads the same in the `ops.mjs` header, the `execute.mjs` header, the inline comment and the battery name.
- Skill lines: `landing-operations.md` 112 lines, longest 120 bytes; `lanes/queue.md` 32 lines, longest 119 bytes. Ceilings 112 and 32, headroom 0, unchanged by the delta.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the prior records: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, published by no package; `skip-changeset` and `Clause-②: no` are right.
